expires_at.description: Valid through the end of this date.

secret.description: qagadm_... - shown this once; send it as X-API-Key.

expires_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null or absent for no expiry.

last_seen_at.description: Last signed in with one of their tokens (to the minute).

status.description: pending: bound at their next SSO sign-in, by a verified email matching theirs; linked: signs in through SSO, their role from their groups

tokens.description: Tokens they hold, expired ones included.

active.description: Update only; false stops all their tokens and sessions at once.

name.description: Create only. Not an API key's name; not 'admin' or 'cli'.

sso.description: Update only: "pending" binds them at their next SSO sign-in; null unlinks them.

agent.description: The caller on the MCP server: a key name, or jwt:<user>.

errors.description: Calls that failed or were refused.

queries.description: Saved queries run, with how many times, most first.

refusals.description: Failures by error code, most first - table_not_allowed, mask_unresolvable, read_only, ...

top_statements.description: Its most frequent ad-hoc statements - by text, or by hash when history keeps only a hash.

writes.description: Its write requests (ADR 0008) by how they ended: pending, approved, done, failed, rejected, expired.

sample_rate.description: Below 1, successful runs are a sample of them.

truncated.description: More runs than one summary reads (100,000).

id.description: Stable while the condition holds: kind and subject.

since.description: When the condition began or will begin, where known (server time).

effective_limits.description: What the key's limits come to against the server's own now: the smaller of each.

expires_at.description: Valid through the end of this date.

previous_expires_at.description: After a rotation: the old secret works until then. Null when none works - never rotated, ended, or its grace is over.

previous_last_used_at.description: When the old secret was last used, while it still works - has the caller switched? (at most once a minute)

secret.description: Shown this once - it cannot be read again.

active.description: Update only; false revokes the key at once.

role.description: Create only: copy this role's grants (no grant fields then).

changes.description: For a change, each field as {from, to}; for a create or delete, the whole record. Never a secret.

hash.description: hmac-sha256:<hex> (QUERYAPIGATE_AUDIT_KEY) or sha256:<hex>, over the previous entry's hash, seq and this entry.

seq.description: Its place in the hash chain (ADR 0012): 1, 2, 3 ... with no gaps.

via.description: How the actor authenticated: a personal admin token, the shared QUERYAPIGATE_API_KEY, an open server, a CLI command or the server's own start-up. Absent on entries written before 0.16.

retention.description: The log keeps this many entries (QUERYAPIGATE_AUDIT_LOG_LIMIT).

break.description: The first entry that does not verify.

keyed.description: Whether the chain is signed with QUERYAPIGATE_AUDIT_KEY.

unchecked_without_key.description: Keyed entries not checked: no key is set to check them with.

meta.description: name, version, connection, format and page, when known.

keys.description: API keys whose collections grant names it.

applied.description: False when nothing needed changing, or for a dry run.

file_sha256.description: The file's hash, as the audit log names it.

fields.description: Each field that changes: {"from": ..., "to": ...}. A stored password shows as <stored secret>, a key's secret as <changed>.

not_in_file.description: What the server has, of the kinds the file has, and the file does not: left alone.

ConfigFile.description: A server's configuration (ADR 0014): `format: queryapigate-config`, `format_version: 1`, and any of connections, destinations, queries, roles, api_keys (each a list of objects with this API's fields), descriptions (by connection) and exports.

file_sha256.description: The file that last applied it.

database.description: The database name, or the file path for SQLite/DuckDB/H2.

options.description: Driver options passed through to the connection (sslmode, jdbc_url, ...).

password.description: Masked as ******** unless it is a ${ENV_VAR} reference; send the mask back (or leave password out) to keep it.

source.description: written by a person, or imported from the database's comments

kept.description: Left as they were - unchanged, or written by a person.

password.description: The secret: masked, or a ${VAR} reference as written.

url.description: An s3://, gs:// or r2:// prefix, or a local folder (file:///path/), ending in /. Exports write under it and nowhere else.

password.description: The secret, or a ${VAR} reference; the mask sent back keeps the stored one.

EncryptionKeys.description: The passwords stored encrypted, by the key in QUERYAPIGATE_SECRET_KEY each is under (ADR 0009).

by_key.description: How many are under each listed key, in order: the first encrypts.

rekeyed.description: How many were re-encrypted under the first key (not with `check`).

under_old_keys.description: How many are under a key other than the first.

values.description: Encrypted passwords stored - connections and destinations.

key_secrets.description: The new example keys' secrets - shown this once.

keys_still_granted.description: Other keys granted an example collection; that grant is now inert.

partial.description: Some are: an interrupted load (POST again completes it).

column.description: Its largest value is the watermark.

parameter.description: The query parameter it is bound to.

start.description: Bound on the first run, before any watermark.

mask.description: Column-masking rules applied to every row the export writes (experimental).

path.description: Under the destination; {name} {date} {time} {run} and {a parameter} are filled in.

query.description: The saved query; its published version runs.

running.description: Whether a run holds its lease now.

skip_empty.description: A run with no rows writes no file.

timeout.description: Seconds, within the server's own limit.

watermark.description: The largest incremental value delivered so far.

column.description: Its largest value is the watermark.

parameter.description: The query parameter it is bound to.

start.description: Bound on the first run, before any watermark.

watermark.description: Update only: set, or (null) reset, the watermark.

object.description: Null when an empty run wrote nothing.

collections.description: Every query in these collections, including ones filed there later.

connections.description: "*" for every connection, or a list of names (ad-hoc SQL and every saved query on them).

mask.description: Column-masking rules applied to everything this caller receives (experimental).

max_concurrent.description: Queries this caller may have running at once, across instances; more get 429 too_many_concurrent (ADR 0011).

max_rows.description: Rows one call may return (a page, a stream, an MCP result) - narrows the server's limit for that kind of call.

queries.description: Saved queries runnable by name, independent of connections; an object entry can allow writes through that one query.

query_timeout.description: Seconds one query may run - narrows the server's, never widens it.

bytes.description: Export runs to a local folder: its size.

code.description: A failed run's error code (API.md, Errors), from 0.13 on.

destination.description: Export runs: the destination written to.

kind.description: A saved query run, or ad-hoc SQL (/execute_sql, /execute_mongo, MCP execute_sql).

object.description: Export runs: the object or file written (null when an empty run wrote none).

params.description: Ad-hoc only: the parameters' names - never their values.

query.description: The saved query; null for ad-hoc SQL.

run_id.description: Export runs: the {run} in the object path.

sql.description: Ad-hoc only, unless QUERYAPIGATE_HISTORY_ADHOC_SQL says 'hash' or 'none'; at most 4000 characters (sql_truncated).

trace_id.description: With tracing on: the trace this run was part of.

transport.description: The front door it came through; export: written to a destination.

next_cursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= for the next page; null on the last.

last_seen.description: Refreshed at most every 30 seconds while it serves.

shared_limits.description: Whether it counts rate limits in Redis (QUERYAPIGATE_REDIS_URL).

column.description: A source column: table.column or schema.table.column, with * as a wildcard - customers.email, *.phone.

capabilities.description: What the role may do in this API (adminroles.py).

data_access.description: Whether it may run SQL and saved queries.

name.description: The administrator's name; 'admin' for the shared key, null on an open server.

default.description: Present only when the parameter has a default.

from_claim.description: Bound from the signed-in caller's token claim.

error.description: Why it could not be analyzed.

on.description: The join condition; empty if none.

cache_ttl.description: The published version's (or newest draft's) response cache TTL, in seconds.

created_at.description: When its first version was saved.

description.description: The published version's, or the newest draft's.

endpoint.description: Where the published version is served, e.g. /q/name.

last_used_at.description: Its newest stored run, of any version; null if it never ran.

agent_writes.description: An AI agent may write through it over MCP: approval - each call approved by a person; insert - an INSERT, without one (ADR 0008).

columns.description: What its result columns mean, by name - in its MCP tool's output schema.

max_affected_rows.description: The most rows one agent write may change; more, and it is rolled back.

placeholders.description: Every parameter the query uses, in order of first use.

run_count.description: Runs of this version stored in history - in a query's detail only.

status.description: published: served now; draft: never served (newer than the published version, or nothing is published); previous: served once, still runnable with ?version=

agent_writes.description: Let AI agents write through it over MCP (ADR 0008): approval, or insert (a single INSERT, no approval). Only an INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE.

author.description: Defaults to the calling key's name.

columns.description: What each result column means, by name: {"amt": "Net revenue in EUR"}.

max_affected_rows.description: With agent_writes: the most rows one agent write may change (default 1).

publish.description: Publish the new version at once instead of keeping it as a draft.

Quota.description: Calls and/or rows per calendar day or month, per caller (experimental, ADR 0011).

notes.description: The connection's own notes - joins, metric definitions.

description.description: What the column means, when described.

masked.description: Over REST and MCP: what the caller's masking rules do to it (hash, mask, null, drop, or refused).

description.description: What the table holds, when described.

env_value.description: The raw value, for a .env export; null at the default and always for a secret.

experimental.description: A setting of an experimental feature (outside the compatibility promise).

value.description: The effective value; a secret only as "configured" or "enabled".

code.description: Stable and machine-readable, e.g. query_not_found, param_invalid, table_not_allowed, rate_limited - every code is listed in API.md under Errors.

detail.description: The database driver's own message, where there is one.

error.description: Human-readable; wording may change between releases.

errors.description: Per-parameter problems, when the parameter rules were invalid.

request_id.description: Matches the X-Request-Id header and the server log.

timeout.description: The time limit that was exceeded, when query_timeout.

trace_id.description: With tracing on: the request's trace, to find it in the tracing backend (experimental, ADR 0010).

arguments.description: Exactly what it runs with - an approval is for these alone.

caller.description: The agent: an API key, or jwt:<user>.

expires_at.description: Approve by then - and, once approved, run by then.

result.description: done: rows_affected and any RETURNING rows; failed: error and code.

info.description: Run SQL against configured databases and get the results back over HTTP.

get.description: Not just what /openapi.json already documents (parameters, description, connection) but the governance half it has no field for: whether a response can be cached and for how long, whether this specific caller can write through this query (may differ per query - see per-query write curation under Authentication and permissions), and this caller's own rate limit alongside the server-wide one. Scoped the same way /openapi.json already scopes its saved-query list - a query this caller cannot reach through /q/<name> is never listed here either. Requires authentication like any other functional endpoint (unlike /openapi.json, this is never public), since the whole point is answering "what can *I* use."

mask.description: This caller's column-masking rules, or null for none.

rate_limit.description: This caller's own additional limit, e.g. "100/minute", or null when it has none of its own.

server_rate_limit.description: QUERYAPIGATE_RATE_LIMIT, checked in addition to rate_limit above, or null when the server has no limit configured.

cache_ttl.description: Seconds a response may be served from cache, or null when uncached.

can_write.description: Whether this caller specifically can write through this query.

masking.description: Only for a caller with column-masking rules: the result columns it gets masked, and how - or, in refused, why its rules would refuse this query (experimental).
